tokens.title: Glossary
tokens.quote: Tokens are the smallest individual units of a language model, and can correspond to words, subwords, characters, or even bytes

chars.title: Glossary
chars.quote: For Claude, a token approximately represents 3.5 English characters, though the exact number can vary depending on the language used.

tokenizer.title: Token counting
tokenizer.quote: Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview use a newer tokenizer. The same input text produces approximately 30 percent more tokens than on earlier models.

window.title: Context windows
window.quote: refers to all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself

everything.title: Context windows
everything.quote: Everything in the request counts toward the context window

output.title: Context windows
output.quote: The output Claude generates for the turn, including its extended thinking, counts too.

sizes-1m.title: Context windows
sizes-1m.quote: Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window.

sizes-200k.title: Context windows
sizes-200k.quote: Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200K-token context window.

too-long.title: Context windows
too-long.quote: If the input alone already exceeds the model's context window, the API returns a 400 invalid_request_error

rot.title: Context windows
rot.quote: As token count grows, accuracy and recall degrade, a phenomenon known as context rot

usage.title: Context windows
usage.quote: Every response reports what the request consumed in its usage field.

max-tokens.title: Create a Message (API reference)
max-tokens.quote: The maximum number of tokens to generate before stopping. Note that our models may stop before reaching this maximum.

usage-in.title: anthropic-sdk-python: types/usage.py
usage-in.quote: The number of input tokens which were used.

usage-out.title: anthropic-sdk-python: types/usage.py
usage-out.quote: The number of output tokens which were used.

count.title: Token counting
count.quote: Token counting lets you determine the number of tokens in a message before you send it to Claude.

estimate.title: Token counting
estimate.quote: The token count is an estimate

count-free.title: Token counting
count-free.quote: Token counting is free to use but subject to requests per minute rate limits

mtok.title: Pricing
mtok.quote: a cache hit costs 5% of the standard input price ($0.20 USD per million tokens)

price-opus.title: Pricing
price-opus.quote: Claude Opus 5.5 For long-running agentic coding and knowledge work $4 / MTok $20 / MTok

price-sonnet.title: Pricing
price-sonnet.quote: Claude Sonnet 5.5 The best combination of speed and intelligence $2 / MTok $10 / MTok

price-haiku.title: Pricing
price-haiku.quote: Claude Haiku 4.5 The fastest model with near-frontier intelligence $1 / MTok $5 / MTok

flat.title: Pricing
flat.quote: A 900K-token request is billed at the same per-token rate as a 9K-token request.

batch.title: Pricing
batch.quote: with a 50% discount on both input and output tokens
